name: Neeed Directory
review_time: Live right away after an automatic check
submit_steps: Pick a listing type > Sign in > Fill in the form > Automatic check runs > Listing goes live right away
notes: Software and digital products only. Free plan plus one-time paid options. Link type is the site's own statement.

name: Startup Fame
notes: Submit URL not found (/submit returns 404). Free listing requires a badge on your site and a review; no-badge listing is paid (per the site's FAQ, checked 2026-10-08). Paid: Highlight $19/month, Spotlight $149/month. Link type is the site's own statement.

name: TinyLaunch
submit_steps: Sign in with email, Google, GitHub or X > Submit the launch form > Embed the TinyLaunch badge on your site to get a dofollow link
notes: Free launch gets a dofollow link when the badge is embedded. Premium and done-for-you options are paid.

name: Dev Hunt
notes: Submit URL not found. Launches are shown as Free. Ads cost $89/week.

name: Findly
submit_steps: Sign in with email, GitHub or Google > Submit the product on /submit
notes: Free listing. Paid done-for-you option.

name: ToolFame
submit_steps: Sign in with email, Google or GitHub > Submit the product on /submit
notes: Link type, pricing and review time not stated on the site.

name: Nick Launches
submit_steps: Open the submit form > Add a logo and screenshots > Pick a plan and a launch week > Save as a draft if needed
notes: Has an MCP server: claude mcp add --transport http nicklaunches https://nicklaunches.com/api/mcp/ (no key; approve in the browser; the agent drafts, a human finishes). Prices not read.

name: Fazier
notes: Basic plan is free. Paid tiers $29 and $49. A high-authority dofollow link is a paid perk.

name: BetaList
submit_steps: Sign in with X or a magic link > Submit the startup on /submit
notes: Free or paid and link type not stated on the page read.

name: LaunchFree
submit_steps: Enter launch name, URL and tagline (80 characters maximum) > Choose category, description (100-1200 characters), origin story, status and pricing > Provide name, email and short bio; agree to terms > Submit for review
notes: Site-stated dofollow, not independently inspected on a published listing; no ranking gain established. Required builder name and bio: brand eligibility must be checked before submission. Optional sponsorship separate. Sources: https://launchfree.io/ ; https://launchfree.io/submit

name: IndieLaunch
review_time: Goes live the day approved; review duration not stated
submit_steps: Sign in with an email code > Paste URL and review generated details > Optionally add and verify badge for dofollow > Submit for manual review
notes: Without badge the free link is nofollow, according to FAQ. Premium offers dofollow without badge. Site states it exposes llms.txt and MCP; this is machine readability, not a verified submission API. Source: https://indielaunch.dev/submit-your-startup

name: LetsLaunch
submit_steps: Choose an available free launch week > Submit product > Place reciprocal badge and pass automatic badge check
notes: Free launches capped at 20/week; badge required by published FAQ. Five-upvotes-in-seven-days retention rule currently paused, subject to change. Markdown and llms-full.txt documented; no submission API verified. Submit URL and account requirement not verified. Do not treat site DR claim as checked DR. Sources: https://letslaunch.today/ ; https://letslaunch.today/developer-tools-directory

name: 10015 Product Finder
submit_steps: Enter live product website URL > Review generated fields, categories and tags > Submit for manual review
notes: Free listings nofollow per FAQ. Priority review and featured/dofollow options paid. Account requirement not verified. Source: https://10015.io/product-finder/submit

name: mcp.tc
review_time: Usually minutes for automated checks; unclear cases manual
submit_steps: Submit public MCP endpoint, GitHub repository or npm/PyPI URL > Checker reads handshake and tools; ambiguous cases held for person > Follow returned status URL for listing or pending outcome
notes: Documented JSON POST /submit accepts url and optional note; no key/account/charge. Leave personal data and secrets out. One listing per server; duplicate detection. Optional claiming later requires account/domain proof. Link type not verified. Sources: https://mcp.tc/submit ; https://mcp.tc/docs/server-owners ; https://mcp.tc/docs/api

name: mcpi.app
submit_steps: Search for existing listing before creating duplicate > Scan domain or fill publish card > Prove control using DNS TXT or well-known HTTP file > Verify and publish
notes: Remote MCP endpoint directory; listing is free, no review queue according to own docs. Existing registry imports should be claimed, not duplicated. Domain proof required; account and outbound link type not verified. Source: https://mcpi.app/docs/directory/publish

name: mcpservers.org
submit_steps: Enter server name, short description, GitHub/docs link, category and contact email > Submit free listing
notes: Free listings stated; review duration/account requirement not stated. $39 premium adds faster review, official badge and dofollow. Do not infer free link type from premium perk. Source: https://mcpservers.org/submit

name: MCP Harbor Registry
submit_steps: Provide reverse-DNS name, title, description, version and transport > Add remote URL for hosted transport or package identifier for stdio > Add tools, tags and optional repository/website/license > Submit into maintainer review queue
notes: Documented JSON API POST /api/v0/servers and submit_server MCP tool. Manual review, not automatic publication. Pricing/account/link type not explicitly verified from submission page. Never include API secret values in environment variables. Source: https://ai.mcpharbor.dev/submit

name: Tolodora
submit_steps: Add name, logo, pitch, screenshots and website > Submit to publish
notes: Site states no queue and free core listing; optional paid premium placement. Badge offered but no mandatory badge verified. Account requirement and followed-link status unknown. Software, SaaS, apps and services eligible per own page. Source: https://tolodora.com/launch

name: MCP Collection
submit_steps: Provide server name, tagline, category, review email and at least one repository/homepage/endpoint URL > Submit via web form or documented JSON API > Hosted endpoint handshake checked; accepted submissions wait for manual review
notes: GET https://mcpcollection.com/api/submit documents field schema, no authentication and POST route. Duplicate returns 409. Link type and review time unstated. Rev-share bundle invitation is separate, not automatic participation. Sources: https://mcpcollection.com/submit ; https://mcpcollection.com/api/submit

name: llmstxt.info
review_time: Within 48 hours editorial review (Standard free plan)
submit_steps: Choose Standard Free, not a paid listing or monitoring plan > Create or provide llms.txt > Complete organization and notification details > Submit for editorial review
notes: Free Standard directory entry explicitly offered; paid expanded listings and monitoring separate. No account needed for check/generator, but listing account requirement not verified. No ranking/indexing/AI-mention guarantee per own FAQ. Plan badges are site display labels, not a verified reciprocal-site requirement. Link type left blank pending direct inspection. Sources: https://llmstxt.info/ ; https://llmstxt.info/submit/?lang=en

name: MCP.Directory
submit_steps: Provide GitHub server repository > Optionally add npm/PyPI package and short description > Provide review notification details and submit
notes: Metadata fetched from GitHub. Pricing/account/link-type not explicitly verified on source page. No auto-approval promise inferred. Source: https://mcp.directory/submit

name: skillz.directory
submit_steps: Provide skill description and repository containing SKILL.md > Provide approval notification contact > Submit for review
notes: Agent skill submissions reviewed before publication. Pricing/account/link-type/review duration not stated in page read. Source: https://skillz.directory/submit

name: skillsdirectory.co
review_time: Worthiness gate within 24 hours; Tier A indexed about 48 hours
submit_steps: Provide fetchable GitHub, package, MCP registry or other supported capability source URL > Identify author/user/third-party relationship and optional context > Submit for worthiness gate
notes: Tier A indexed; Tier B listing noindex until more signal; Tier C declined. A listing is not necessarily indexed. Pricing/account/link type unstated. Source: https://skillsdirectory.co/submit

name: SkillsLookup
submit_steps: Provide direct repository URL and skill name > Describe outcomes accurately with category and documentation > Submit for manual review
notes: Accepts agent skills and MCP servers. Maintenance, setup documentation and reproducible examples considered. Pricing/account/link type not stated. Source: https://skillslookup.com/submit-skill

name: llmstxt.site
submit_steps: Provide product name and llms.txt URL > Add llms-full.txt URL and contextual notes if available > Submit directory suggestion
notes: Directory of llms.txt locations. No stated review duration, account requirement, pricing or outbound link type in form read. Source: https://llmstxt.site/submit

name: CuratedMCP
submit_steps: Provide server name, GitHub URL, tagline and install command > Publish using directory listing route
notes: Free core listing explicitly stated; security certification and monetization optional, not included evidence of certification. Account/review duration/outbound-link type unknown. Six-client installation configs advertised, not independently tested. Source: https://www.curatedmcp.com/publish
